exposure: anaemia in the third trimester of pregnancy
non-utilisation of insecticide-treated bed nets (ITNs) during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 422 mothers who delivered in public health facilities and reside in the Savelugu Municipality of Northern Ghana.
finding: Anaemia in the third trimester, positive sickle cell status, and non-utilisation of insecticide-treated bed nets during pregnancy were significantly associated with an increased risk of stillbirths.
cross-section timing: Data was gathered from mothers who delivered in public health facilities regarding their sociodemographic, obstetric, and medical history.
